newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable, market quiet.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable, market quiet.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were generally stable in quiet late trading on Wednesday as cautious buyers stayed sidelined, traders said.
They said olein was quoted unchanged from the opening level of 1,430-35 rupiah/kg in Jakarta but was slightly lower from Tuesday's close of 1,440 rupiah.
"Demand was weak today," one trader said. "It's uncertain if prices will continue falling or if the market is beginning to consolidate after rising sharply."
Olein prices have climbed to current levels from 1,360 rupiah two weeks ago on adjustment to crude palm oil values.
Another trader said olein prices could come under pressure on aggressive selling by profit-taking players.
"I see prices weakening a little more tomorrow," the trader said. "But I don't see prices declining sharply."
Data from Belawan Port showed that the MT Chavchavadze will leave the North Sumatran port on Thursday with 3,000 tonnes of olein for Port Klang, Malaysia.
The MT Wanea will leave for Tanjung Priok in Jakarta today with 1,000 tonnes of olein.
The MT Acada Dolphin will leave today for China with 2,000 tonnes of stearin, while the KM Matahari 19 will leave for Tanjung Priok today with 1,000 tonnes of olein.
The MT Cakra l will leave on Thursday for Tanjung Priok with 2,000 tonnes olein. The MT Prabu left Belawan on Monday for Tanjung Priok port with 1,800 tonnes of olein.
